name: West Pharmaceutical Services

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Logo of West Pharmaceutical Services (2020).svg)

description: West makes the rubber stoppers, seals, syringe parts, plastic vials and self-injection devices that go on and into injectable drug packages, and sells them to drugmakers (biologics 40% of sales, generics 17%, pharma 24%). Its Proprietary Products segment is 81% of sales and 91% of segment profit because its components are written into each drug's regulatory filing, so customers rarely switch and reorder with every production batch. A smaller Contract-Manufactured segment (19% of sales, 10.9% margin) builds devices designed by customers. It is a packaging and components supplier to pharma, not a medical-device or lab-tools company, and its fortunes track injectable drug volumes such as GLP-1s. Net sales were $3,074 million in 2025 and rose 17% in the first half of 2026.

businessLines.name: Proprietary Products
businessLines.how: Sells elastomer stoppers, seals, syringe and cartridge components, drug-delivery devices and containment vials to biologic, generic and pharma drugmakers, where the part is specified into the drug filing and bought repeatedly with each production batch; also analytical lab and packaging-support services.

businessLines.name: Contract-Manufactured Products
businessLines.how: Designs, molds and automates the assembly of complex customer-owned devices (surgical, diagnostic, ophthalmic, injectable) under contract; paid per unit produced plus development and tooling agreements.

brands.name: High-Value Product Components / Delivery Devices / Standard Packaging
brands.note: Product categories as shares of company net sales: 47%, 13%, 21% (Contract-Manufactured 19%).
